About Above and Beyond

Local, family-owned — and it shows

Above and Beyond Pest Control is a family-owned and operated company rooted in the Lake Worth, Florida community. Our local ties mean we understand the unique pest challenges of our area — and can provide tailored solutions that truly work.

We use Integrated Pest Management: a multi-tactic approach that studies the biology and behavior of each pest, then combines biological controls and habitat changes to lower risk — while reducing pesticide use whenever possible.

Our team holds the required Florida credentials, follows local and state guidelines, and applies the latest industry-safe methods.
